title: Presto Petronella
author: Cary Ravitz
problems: Row 3 "circle left 3 places and pass through up and down to face your partner · circle" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 3 "circle left 3 places and pass through up and down to face your partner · pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 5 "balance & petronella · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "balance & petronella · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "balance & petronella · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "balance & petronella · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 2 and 3 are too far apart to balance.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 3 "circle left 3 places and pass through up and down to face your partner · pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
